theorem backend.sData_put_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (bi :
    backend.BucketInfo) (k v : GoString) (seq : Bool) (nk : GoString × GoString) : backend.sData P
    (st.put bi k v seq).S !! nk = if P.HB nk.fst = true then none else if nk = (bi.name, k) then
    some v else backend.sData P st.S !! nk

theorem backend.dlsS_delBucket {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {bi : backend.BucketInfo}
    (hSB : P.SB bi.name = false) (h : backend.dlsS P st) : backend.dlsS P (st.delBucket bi)

theorem backend.dlsOk_create {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {L : GMap (GoString ×
    GoString) GoString} {bi : backend.BucketInfo} (h : backend.dlsOk P st L) : backend.dlsOk P
    (st.create bi) L

theorem backend.dget_bktOf (D : backend.Data) (n k : GoString) : backend.dget D n k = backend.bktOf
    D n !! k

theorem backend.dlsS_of_dlsOk {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {L : GMap (GoString ×
    GoString) GoString} (h : backend.dlsOk P st L) : backend.dlsS P st

theorem backend.sData_del_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (bi :
    backend.BucketInfo) (k : GoString) (nk : GoString × GoString) : backend.sData P (st.del bi k).S
    !! nk = if nk = (bi.name, k) then none else backend.sData P st.S !! nk

theorem backend.dlsS_put {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {bi : backend.BucketInfo} {k v :
    GoString} (seq : Bool) (hk : P.SB bi.name = true → P.HB bi.name = false → st.dl !! (bi.name, k)
    = none) (h : backend.dlsS P st) : backend.dlsS P (st.put bi k v seq)

    P.HB bi.name = false → st.dl !! (bi.name, k) = none) (h : backend.dlsOk P st L) : backend.dlsOk
    P (st.put bi k v seq) L

theorem backend.dlVd_of_dlsOk {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {L : GMap (GoString ×
    GoString) GoString} (h : backend.dlsOk P st L) : backend.dlVd P (backend.sData P st.S) L
    (backend.dlR P st.dl)

theorem backend.dlR_lookup_sb (P : backend.BParams) (X : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) {nk :
    GoString × GoString} (h1 : P.SB nk.fst = true) (h2 : P.HB nk.fst = false) : backend.dlR P X !!
    nk = X !! nk

theorem backend.dlR_del_other (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo)
    (k : GoString) (h : P.SB bi.name = false ∨ P.HB bi.name = true) : backend.dlR P (st.del bi k).dl
    = backend.dlR P st.dl

theorem backend.dlsS_del {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {bi : backend.BucketInfo} {k :
    GoString} (h : backend.dlsS P st) : backend.dlsS P (st.del bi k)

    GoString) GoString} (hS : backend.sData P st'.S = backend.sData P st.S) (hD : backend.dlR P
    st'.dl = backend.dlR P st.dl) (h : backend.dlsOk P st L) : backend.dlsOk P st' L

theorem backend.dlsOk_delBucket {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {L : GMap (GoString ×
    GoString) GoString} {bi : backend.BucketInfo} (hSB : P.SB bi.name = false) (h : backend.dlsOk P
    st L) : backend.dlsOk P (st.delBucket bi) L

theorem backend.dlsOk_del {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {L : GMap (GoString × GoString)
    GoString} {bi : backend.BucketInfo} {k : GoString} (hL : P.SB bi.name = true → P.HB bi.name =
    false → backend.sData P st.S !! (bi.name, k) ≠ none → L !! (bi.name, k) ≠ none) (h :
    backend.dlsOk P st L) : backend.dlsOk P (st.del bi k) L

theorem backend.sData_lookupD (P : backend.BParams) (S : backend.Data) (nk : GoString × GoString) :
    backend.sData P S !! nk = if P.HB nk.fst = true then none else backend.dget S nk.fst nk.snd

theorem backend.dlsW_exact {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} (hdl : st.dl = ∅) (hwin :
    st.win = false) : backend.dlsW P st (backend.sData P st.S)

theorem backend.dlR_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (X : GMap (GoString × GoString) GoString) (nk :
    GoString × GoString) : backend.dlR P X !! nk = if P.SB nk.fst = true ∧ P.HB nk.fst = false then
    X !! nk else none

theorem backend.dlsS_create {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} {bi : backend.BucketInfo} (h
    : backend.dlsS P st) : backend.dlsS P (st.create bi)

theorem backend.dlsOk_exact {P : backend.BParams} {st : backend.BSess} (hdl : st.dl = ∅) :
    backend.dlsOk P st (backend.sData P st.S)

theorem backend.dlsW_step {P : backend.BParams} {st st' : backend.BSess} {L : GMap (GoString ×
    GoString) GoString} (hS : backend.dlsS P st → backend.dlsS P st') (hO : backend.dlsOk P st L →
    backend.dlsOk P st' L) (hwin : st'.win = st.win) (hhw : st'.cnt.hw = st.cnt.hw) (h :
    backend.dlsW P st L) : backend.dlsW P st' L

theorem backend.del_dl_lookup (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) (k : GoString) (nk :
    GoString × GoString) : (st.del bi k).dl !! nk = if nk = (bi.name, k) then (backend.bktOf st.S
    bi.name !! k).or (st.dl !! nk) else st.dl !! nk

theorem backend.dlsS_congr {P : backend.BParams} {st st' : backend.BSess} (hS : backend.sData P
    st'.S = backend.sData P st.S) (hD : backend.dlR P st'.dl = backend.dlR P st.dl) (h :
    backend.dlsS P st) : backend.dlsS P st'

theorem backend.sData_delBucket_lookup (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (bi :
    backend.BucketInfo) (nk : GoString × GoString) (hn : nk.fst ≠ bi.name) : backend.sData P
    (st.delBucket bi).S !! nk = backend.sData P st.S !! nk

theorem backend.sData_create (P : backend.BParams) (st : backend.BSess) (bi : backend.BucketInfo) :
    backend.sData P (st.create bi).S = backend.sData P st.S
